corrections.text: The article states, citing Engadget, that 'The charges name Microsoft subsidiaries including Activision, Blizzard, King, Mojang, Xbox Game Studios and ZeniMax, the parent of Arkane, Bethesda, id Software, MachineGames and ZeniMax Online.' Engadget presents that list as the studios the layoffs hit, not the entities named in the unfair labor practice charges. Game Developer, which describes the charge itself, reports it was filed 'against Microsoft and subsidiaries including Xbox, ZeniMax Media, Inc, id Software, Bethesda Game Studios and more' — a narrower set that does not include Activision, Blizzard, King or Mojang.
